steps.title: Verify Metadata Configuration
steps.description: Inspect app-meta.json to confirm that the app name 'Focus Timer' and target package 'com.focustimer.app' are correctly specified.

steps.title: Analyze Build Script Dependencies
steps.description: Scan build.gradle for unsupported external third-party dependencies that might cause compilation errors or runtime problems.

steps.title: Remove Third-Party Dependencies
steps.description: Clean up build.gradle by removing the unauthorized nanohttpd library dependency to ensure a clean native build.

steps.title: Inspect Manifest Properties
steps.description: Verify the package, theme declarations, and main activity mapping inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Review Layout Namespace Configs
steps.description: Examine layout XML files to find incorrect namespace definitions that cause application inflation crashes upon launch.

steps.title: Correct Layout Namespace Errors
steps.description: Replace the incorrect github.com schema URL with the standard android.com XML namespace declaration in activity_main.xml to resolve immediate crashes.

steps.title: Validate Circular Progress Canvas
steps.description: Confirm the custom rendering logic within CircularProgressView.java works smoothly with native graphic context and paints.

steps.title: Audit Core Controller Logic
steps.description: Check MainActivity.java setup phases, ensuring view initialization runs prior to any logic requiring references to layout elements.

steps.title: Verify UI Elements Mapping
steps.description: Verify that all view element IDs accessed programmatically in MainActivity have exact counterparts in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Verify SharedPreferences Flow
steps.description: Audit persistence methods that handle focus session counts, timers, and metrics history cleanly.

steps.title: Verify Navigation Controllers
steps.description: Check tab listeners and visibility switches to ensure flawless transitioning between timer, logs, and preference configuration panels.

steps.title: Verify Tone Notification Logic
steps.description: Ensure sound completion indicators trigger clean tone generation fallbacks across diverse device hardware.

steps.title: Building Focus Timer
steps.description: Initiate absolute validation of native compilation paths, manifest properties, and layout alignments to assemble the final APK successfully.
